title: I think nature is reclaiming my mallworld…
content: My mall world has changed over time. I can still vividly recall many details of my mall itself; the boutiques with pillars, the service corridors, and the triangular burger place outside…but it’s been years since my dreams took me there. Some of my other prominent buildings still feature, like the library/university with the floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the city, and occasionally the impossibly tall council flats on a hill. These days, I mostly dream of countryside villages and medieval market towns. One in particular has concentric walls with flowerbeds and a moat. Inside the town looks like Machu Picchu, with modern stores on different levels. The stores have various entrances, but no doors to open or close. At night, industrial lights illuminate the bare rock walls and natural formations, like those used outdoors or inside a cave. Has anyone else seen this?
